calibration_choice: Highest HOTA among the three fixed variants whose absolute proposal recall loss is at most 0.02 for All, Base, and Novel; ties use A/B/C order
no_eligible_variant: Confirm the variant with least All recall loss (ties by A/B/C order), but do not run full unless the same safety gates pass
confirmation: Evaluate only the calibration-locked variant and frozen Original FG-0 on the preregistered disjoint 20-video set
full_gate: Require observed duplication, at least 20% fewer candidates, at most 0.02 absolute All/Base/Novel recall loss, HOTA improvement >=0.005, DetA improvement >=0.002 and identical GT/evaluator; check the same recall gates on both subsets
parameter_scope: Only A/B/C tracking-only NMS and max-box controls; ByteTrack and frozen model artifacts unchanged
